pages.title: Chapter Bylaws
pages.body:
Adopted March 1974. Last amended October 2023.

ARTICLE I. NAME
This body shall be known as the Chapter of the National Alumni Association, chartered under the constitution of the parent association.

ARTICLE II. PURPOSE
To perpetuate the bond between the University and its graduates, to raise and award scholarship funds to deserving students, and to support the University's mission through service and advocacy.

ARTICLE III. MEMBERSHIP
Membership shall be open to all graduates and former students in good standing, and to friends of the University approved by a two-thirds vote.

pages.title: Officers
pages.body: Officers serve two-year terms beginning July 1 of even-numbered years. Nominations open each spring and are presented to the membership at the April meeting.

pages.title: Membership Levels
pages.body:
Annual — $50. Full voting rights, newsletter, directory listing.

Life — $750, payable in five annual installments. All annual benefits, permanent directory listing, and recognition at the fall banquet.

Young Alumni — $25. For graduates within five years of commencement.

Golden — Complimentary for graduates of fifty years or more.

pages.title: Committees
pages.body: Every member is asked to serve on at least one committee. Committees meet between general meetings and report at each monthly gathering.

pages.title: Scholarship
pages.body: The chapter awards two scholarships each spring to graduating seniors from the county who have been admitted to the University. Applications open January 15 and close March 1.

pages.title: Fundraising Teams
pages.body: Fish fry, spring gala, and the Homecoming raffle. Team captains are named each September.

pages.title: Meetings
pages.body: General membership meets the second Saturday of each month at 10:00 a.m. Executive board meets the preceding Tuesday at 7:00 p.m. No general meeting in July or December.

pages.title: Special Recognition
pages.body: Members who have given twenty-five years or more of continuous service, and those we have lost since the last directory was printed.
